gene symbol: HNF1A [46]. gene name: HNF1A [49]. The protein encoded by this gene is a transcription factor required for the expression of several liver-specific genes [55]. The encoded protein functions as a homodimer and binds to the inverted palindrome 5'-GTTAATNATTAAC-3' [55]. Defects in this gene are a cause of maturity onset diabetes of the young type 3 (MODY3) and also can result in the appearance of hepatic adenomas [55]. Alternative splicing results in multiple transcript variants encoding different isoforms [55]. [provided by RefSeq, Apr 2015] [55].
